svg.title: Spatial compression and decompression
svg.desc: A schematic Global C4 example. On each frame and channel, a trainable depthwise Conv2D reduces each full 4x4 canonical cell to one token. After attention, fixed bilinear spatial upsampling followed by trainable depthwise Conv3D refinement restores the fine spatial grid. Temporal length and channel count are preserved. Color grids are schematic and decompression is not an exact inverse. Adaptive reuses the same primitives with C2/C4 cells. Attention and RoPE are shown in the main architecture and intentionally outside this inset.

g.aria-label: Spatial resolution changes; temporal length T and channels D are preserved.
